cte_count.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t;

cte_correlated_exists.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,10000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value);

direct_correlated_exists.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(1,10000)t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(1,10000)t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value);

cte_count_materialized.sql: WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t;

cte_count_not_materialized.sql: WITH t AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t;

cte_body_filter_count.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000) WHERE value<=500000) SELECT count(*) FROM t;

cte_outer_filter_count.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE value<=500000;

cte_projected_sum.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value*2+1 AS n FROM generate_series(1,1000000)) SELECT sum(n) FROM t;

cte_named_column_sum.sql: WITH t(n) AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000)) SELECT sum(n) FROM t;

cte_hidden_column_sum.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value,start,stop,step FROM generate_series(1,1000000,2)) SELECT sum(start+step)+max(stop)-max(value) FROM t;

cte_hidden_constraint_miss.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value,step FROM generate_series(1,1000000,2)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE step=3;

cte_limited_sum.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000) LIMIT 100 OFFSET 10) SELECT sum(value) FROM t;

cte_ordered_limit_sum.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000000) ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT sum(value) FROM t;

cte_empty_count.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(2,1)) SELECT count(*) FROM t;

cte_multiple_reference_sum.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,100000)) SELECT (SELECT sum(value) FROM t)+(SELECT count(*) FROM t);

cte_correlated_exists_materialized.sql: WITH t AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value);

cte_correlated_exists_not_materialized.sql: WITH t AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value);

cte_correlated_miss.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value+1000);

direct_correlated_miss.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(1,1000)t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(1,1000)t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value+1000);

cte_correlated_offset.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT value FROM generate_series(1,1000)) SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t t1 WHERE t.value=t1.value+1);
